SECURED PROMISSORY NOTE

$750,000.00                                                    Chicago, Illinois
                                                               April 14, 2026

FOR VALUE RECEIVED, LARKSPUR ASSAY SYSTEMS, INC., a Delaware corporation (the "Borrower"), promises to pay to the order of NORTHBRIDGE SAVINGS BANK, an Illinois banking corporation (the "Lender"), at 88 Superior Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60611, or at such other place as the holder may designate, the principal sum of SEVEN HUNDRED FIFTY THOUSAND AND 00/100 DOLLARS ($750,000.00), together with interest, on the terms below.

1. INTEREST. Interest accrues on the unpaid principal balance from the date of this Note at a fixed rate of eight and one-quarter percent (8.25%) per annum, computed on the basis of a 360-day year and the actual number of days elapsed.

2. PAYMENTS. The Borrower will pay sixty (60) consecutive monthly installments of principal and interest of $15,289.42 each, beginning June 1, 2026 and continuing on the first day of each month thereafter, with all remaining principal and accrued interest due on May 1, 2031 (the "Maturity Date").

3. PREPAYMENT. The Borrower may prepay in whole or in part at any time without premium or penalty. A partial prepayment is applied first to accrued interest and then to principal in inverse order of maturity, and does not postpone any scheduled installment.

4. LATE CHARGE. If any installment is not paid within ten (10) days after it is due, the Borrower will pay a late charge of five percent (5%) of the overdue installment. A late charge is a one-time charge and does not accrue.

5. DEFAULT RATE. On and after an Event of Default, the unpaid principal bears interest at the lesser of (a) the rate in Section 1 plus four percent (4%) per annum, and (b) the maximum rate permitted by applicable law.

6. USURY SAVINGS. Nothing in this Note requires the Borrower to pay interest at a rate exceeding the maximum permitted by law. If any payment would exceed that maximum, the excess is applied to reduce principal, and if principal has been paid in full, refunded to the Borrower. It is the intent of the Borrower and the Lender to conform strictly to the applicable usury laws, and this Section controls over every other provision.

7. SECURITY. This Note is secured by a Security Agreement of even date granting the Lender a first-priority security interest in the Borrower's equipment, inventory, accounts, and general intangibles, perfected by a UCC-1 financing statement filed with the Illinois Secretary of State.

8. EVENTS OF DEFAULT. Each of the following is an "Event of Default": failure to pay any amount within ten (10) days after it is due; breach of any covenant in the Security Agreement not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice; any representation proving materially false when made; the Borrower's insolvency, assignment for the benefit of creditors, or the commencement of a bankruptcy proceeding not dismissed within sixty (60) days; or the entry of a judgment against the Borrower exceeding $100,000 that is not stayed or satisfied within thirty (30) days.

9. ACCELERATION. On an Event of Default, the holder may declare the entire unpaid principal and accrued interest immediately due and payable, after giving the Borrower the notice and opportunity to cure that Section 8 provides, and may exercise every remedy under the Security Agreement and the Uniform Commercial Code.

10. COLLECTION COSTS. The Borrower will pay the holder's reasonable attorneys' fees and costs actually incurred in collecting this Note or enforcing the Security Agreement.

11. WAIVERS. The Borrower waives presentment, demand for payment, notice of dishonor, protest, and notice of protest. NO CONFESSION OF JUDGMENT. The Borrower does not authorize any attorney to confess judgment against it, and nothing in this Note is a warrant of attorney or a cognovit.

12. NO JURY WAIVER. Neither party waives trial by jury.

13. GOVERNING LAW. Illinois law governs this Note, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Venue lies in the Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois.

LARKSPUR ASSAY SYSTEMS, INC.
